Usage: sieve map [options] [dir]

Token-budgeted repo orientation — directory clusters, per-directory hubs, and
global hotspots from the symbol graph ($0, no LLM)

Arguments:
  dir             repository root (default: the nearest folder with a sieve/
                  index; the walk stops at a linked git worktree)

Options:
  --max-dirs <n>  max directory entries shown, rest counted into dropped
                  (default 16)
  --in <path>     map only the files under this path prefix (segment-aware,
                  like query)
  --json          output as JSON
  --no-refresh    skip the freshness check — answer from the graph as-is
  -h, --help      display help for command
